<description>
Kills some live mutants on `interpreter.cpp` found by https://bitcoincore.space. They are:

[interpreter.cpp#5168](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/interpreter.cpp#5168): `IsCompressedOrUncompressedPubKey`: pubkey with neither compressed nor uncompressed prefix returns `true`

```diff
-    } else if (vchPubKey[0] == 0x02 || vchPubKey[0] == 0x03) {
+    } else if (1==1) {
```

[interpreter.cpp#5191](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/interpreter.cpp#5191): `IsValidSignatureEncoding`: 73-byte upper bound returns `true`

```diff
     if (sig.size() < 9) return false;
-    if (sig.size() > 73) return false;
```

[interpreter.cpp#5200](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/interpreter.cpp#5200): `IsValidSignatureEncoding`: total-length byte check returns `true`

```diff
     // Make sure the length covers the entire signature.
-    if (sig[1] != sig.size() - 3) return false;
```

[interpreter.cpp#5232](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/interpreter.cpp#5232): `IsValidSignatureEncoding`: null R byte check `lenR > 1` -> `lenR >=1`

```diff
     // Null bytes at the start of R are not allowed, unless R would
     // otherwise be interpreted as a negative number.
-    if (lenR > 1 && (sig[4] == 0x00) && !(sig[5] & 0x80)) return false;
+    if (lenR >= 1 && (sig[4] == 0x00) && !(sig[5] & 0x80)) return false;
```

[interpreter.cpp#5259](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/interpreter.cpp#5259): `IsValidSignatureEncoding`: null S byte check `lenS > 1` -> `lenS >= 1`

```diff
     // Null bytes at the start of S are not allowed, unless S would otherwise be
     // interpreted as a negative number.
-    if (lenS > 1 && (sig[lenR + 6] == 0x00) && !(sig[lenR + 7] & 0x80)) return false;
+    if (lenS >= 1 && (sig[lenR + 6] == 0x00) && !(sig[lenR + 7] & 0x80)) return false;
```

[interpreter.cpp#5186](https://bitcoincore.space/src/script/interpreter.cpp#5186): `IsValidSignatureEncoding`: 9-byte lower bound returns `true`

```diff
     // Minimum and maximum size constraints.
-    if (sig.size() < 9) return false;
```

The first affects policy only, the next four affect consensus, and the last covers the lower bound and lets ASan catch UB: a 3-byte signature reaches the `sig[3]` read that the `sig.size() < 9` guard protects.

Recommend reviewing per commit.
</description>
